import {
  BaseSubgraph as Base,
  type SchemaBuilder,
} from "@powerhousedao/reactor-api";
import { gql } from "graphql-tag";

export class InlineSubgraph extends Base {
  static override readonly subgraphName = "inline";
  static override getSchema(schemaBuilder: SchemaBuilder<InlineSubgraph>) {
    return schemaBuilder.graphql({
      typeDefs: gql`
        scalar Date
        enum Choice {
          YES
          NO
        }
        interface Node {
          id: ID!
        }
        type Item implements Node {
          id: ID!
        }
        type Query {
          item: Node
          date: Date
        }
        type Updates {
          item: Item
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          subscription: Updates
        }
      `,
      resolverCoordinates: [
        {
          typeName: "Date",
          fieldName: null,
          resolverKind: "scalar",
        },
        {
          typeName: "Choice",
          fieldName: null,
          resolverKind: "enum",
        },
        {
          typeName: "Node",
          fieldName: null,
          resolverKind: "resolveType",
        },
        {
          typeName: "Item",
          fieldName: null,
          resolverKind: "isTypeOf",
        },
        {
          typeName: "Query",
          fieldName: "item",
          resolverKind: "field",
        },
        {
          typeName: "Query",
          fieldName: "date",
          resolverKind: "field",
        },
        {
          typeName: "Updates",
          fieldName: "item",
          resolverKind: "subscribe",
        },
        {
          typeName: "Updates",
          fieldName: "item",
          resolverKind: "resolve",
        },
      ],
      resolvers: (s) => ({
        Date: { serialize: (value: unknown) => value },
        Choice: { YES: "yes", NO: "no" },
        Node: { __resolveType: () => "Item" },
        Item: {
          __isTypeOf: function (this: { valid: boolean }) {
            return this.valid;
          },
        },
        Query: { item: () => ({ id: "1" }), date: () => s.label },
        Updates: {
          item: {
            subscribe: async function* () {
              yield { id: "1" };
            },
            resolve: (value: unknown) => value,
          },
        },
      }),
    });
  }
  readonly label = "today";
}
